title: The reducer change of BG-hfakjbdf moves the doc hash of every github.com page row once, and web-sources.md says nothing of the one false change
goal: kb/_self/web-sources.md names that the reducer's skipping of role=tooltip and visually hidden elements changes the stored doc_sha256 of a github.com page row once without the page changing, or the rows are re-baselined, so the first detect after the change is not read as a source change. Found by the SP-c6tr77jl review (S3; 110 github.com rows of kb/public/_fetch_state.csv hold a doc_sha256).

run: import sys;t=open("kb/_self/web-sources.md",encoding="utf-8").read().lower();sys.exit(0 if "role=tooltip" in t and "once" in t and "doc_sha256" in t else 1)

repro_reason: the false change shows only on a live detect of a github.com page, which needs the network; the repro reads that web-sources.md names the one-time change
